Lina (partnerships): Quick heads-up 1: KeyBridge Systems (HSM vendor) proposed a joint marketplace launch + co-blog. They need SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, KMIP/KMS key-wrap integration, and a Redwood secrets connector. Proposed go-live week: June 21. Who's available for a short sync? :calendar:
Omar (product): I can make time. We should confirm embargo and a single demo flow (console + API).
Nisha (security): Need FIPS 140-3 cert, attestation report, and a statement that private key material never leaves the HSM (wrapped-only export). Also want to see KMIP endpoint details.
KeyBridge Rep: Hi all 1: we have FIPS 140-3 and an attestation PDF. KMIP endpoint: `kmip.keybridge.example.com:5696`. We support RSA-OAEP-256 and AES-KW. We also have a managed REST facade for cloud: `https://api.keybridge.example.com/kms/v1/wrap`.
Kunal (eng): For integration, please provide example KMIP wrap/unwrap exchange or REST sample. Also need a test HSM instance + service account for DevX.
KeyBridge Rep: We'll provision a short-lived test tenant and drop creds in the shared folder. Timeline: staging by June 7, QA week June 10-14, freeze June 17 for marketing assets.
DevX (devex): I'll want a SCIM sandbox and a few test users from KeyBridge for provisioning tests. Can you share SCIM base URL and any custom schema attributes?
KeyBridge Rep: SCIM base: `https://scim.keybridge.example.com/v2`. We have a custom attr `x:hardware_id` for HSM mapping. We'll share mapping doc.
Omar (product): Action list: 1) attestation + certs (KeyBridge), 2) staging creds + SCIM sandbox (KeyBridge), 3) SCIM mapping + sample payload (Kunal/DevX), 4) legal MOU + embargo window (LegalBot), 5) demo script + webinar plan (Omar/Lina).
Kunal (eng): SCIM sample we plan to use (draft):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},
  "active": true,
  "externalId": "emp-1234",
  "x:hardware_id": "hb-9a8b7c",
  "groups": ["platform-team"]
}
```
Nisha (security): Please include a clause in the MOU: no unwrapped key export; partner must publish attestation and allow us to audit logs for wrap ops.
KeyBridge Rep: Agreed on wrapped-only policy; we'll include audit log access for the test tenant.
LegalBot: Draft MOU template will be posted to the shared drive today. Recommend 72-hour embargo after asset sign-off to allow legal review.
DevX (devex): Created a calendar hold for a 30m sync: Wed June 8 9:30am PT. calendar-bot: meeting scheduled.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: partnerships x KeyBridge onboarding 1: Wed June 8 9:30am PT. Zoom link in invite.
Lina (partnerships): Great. Last asks before the sync: KeyBridge please upload attestation + staging creds; LegalBot drop MOU; DevX prep SCIM test set and a short runbook for the console demo. We'll run integration QA the week of June 10.
Omar (product): I'll draft the demo steps and API snippet for the blog. Example connector config to test: `secrets://redwood/connectors/keybridge?kms_url=https://api.keybridge.example.com&wrap_algo=RSA-OAEP-256`
Kunal (eng): Noted. We'll validate KMIP flow and REST wrapper during staging.
KeyBridge Rep: Uploading docs and credentials now. Looking forward to the sync.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks everyone 1: we'll convert these into tasks after the call.
